DISTRIBUTION. — Lychnothamnus major has hitherto been recorded from numerous European sites of various ages within the Rupelian. In France, this species occurs in the Paris (Grambast & Paul 1965; Riveline 1986), Aquitaine (Feist & Ringeade 1977), Provence (Feist-Castel 1977 a) and Languedoc (Grambast 1962) basins. In Germany, this species has been documented by Feist-Castel (1977 a) and Schwarz (1985). Moreover, Kissling (1974) reported this species in the western sector of the Swiss Molasse and Baciu and Feist (1999) from north-western Romania. In Spain, it has already been described from some localities of the Ebro Basin by Choi (1989) and we found it in Sarral and El Talladell (Table 4).
